description: This file defines functions, types, and constants related to provider wizard options, provider plugin choices, caching, and provider selection logic within the openclaw project. It manages provider configurations, cache handling, and selection of provider methods and models.

classes.name: ProviderWizardCacheEntry
classes.description: Type representing a cache entry for provider wizard data, including expiration time and list of provider plugins.

methods.name: buildProviderPluginMethodChoice
methods.description: Constructs a provider plugin method choice string from provider and method IDs.

methods.name: resolveProviderWizardProviders
methods.description: Resolves and caches provider plugins based on configuration, environment, and cache settings.

methods.name: resolveProviderWizardOptions
methods.description: Generates a list of provider wizard options for UI selection based on available provider plugins.

methods.name: resolveProviderModelPickerEntries
methods.description: Returns entries for provider model pickers based on available provider plugins.

methods.name: resolveProviderPluginChoice
methods.description: Resolves a provider plugin choice string to the corresponding provider, method, and wizard setup.

methods.name: runProviderModelSelectedHook
methods.description: Executes the onModelSelected hook for a provider when a model is selected.
